project.name: Hello, Stranger
project.type: A One-of-a-Kind Interactive Birthday Experience (not a template website)
project.objective: Build something Arshiya has genuinely never seen before — a small, obsessively-crafted digital world she opens on her birthday and can't stop scrolling through. It should feel like a cinematic short film she gets to control, not a webpage with sections. No stock photography, no filler — every scene is built, lit, and animated from scratch.

creative_concept.big_idea: The whole site is framed as a single unfolding evening — she starts at dusk, in a quiet golden room made of light and particles, and by the end she's standing inside a sunrise. No photographs are used anywhere; everything she sees is generated from typography, light, particles, and abstract 3D form. The 'story' is entirely told through words, motion and atmosphere.
narrative_arc: Dusk: a mysterious, playful opening — someone is talking directly to her
Warm teasing and shared history, told through kinetic typography rather than pictures
The turn: her birthday itself, a burst of light and celebration
The quiet part: acknowledging the wedding ahead, honestly and gently
The reassurance: a slow build toward calm and confidence
Sunrise: the finale, bright, hopeful, and unmistakably hers

typography.display: A high-contrast modern serif for hero and section headlines — treated as an art object, animated in 3D depth
typography.body: A refined, warm sans-serif for supporting copy
typography.script: A single elegant handwritten face, used ONLY for the closing signature — the one moment of true intimacy in the whole site

sequence: A single thin gold line draws itself horizontally across the screen.
A minimal percentage counter (0–100) appears beside it in oxblood, tracked with a trailing gold particle.
At 100%, the line becomes a bright horizontal seam of light that widens into a GSAP clip-path reveal.
The hero scene appears as if a curtain of light has just opened.

scenes.goal: Stop the scroll immediately. This is the 'wow, wait' moment.

type_sequence.text: Yes, you. Don’t look behind you.

scenes.headline: A stranger who didn’t stay a stranger.
scenes.body: Somewhere between the random conversations, stupid jokes, serious moments and unforgettable memories, you became someone genuinely important to me.

scenes.headline: You’re still strange.
scenes.body: After careful observation and years of research, I have reached one important conclusion: you are still strange. But you’re my favourite kind of strange.

interaction.on_click: The headline shakes with a quick elastic snap and 'Evidence confirmed.' appears beneath it, with a small burst of gold confetti-like particles (no emoji).

scenes.headline: Happy Birthday, Arshiya.
scenes.body: Today is about celebrating the kind, funny, slightly strange and genuinely wonderful person you are.
scenes.completion_effect: A soft screen-wide bloom of gold particles reveals a hidden line beneath: 'Your wish has officially entered the universe. No refunds.'

scenes.headline: You don’t have to carry everything alone.
body: I know your wedding is getting closer, and there may be moments when everything feels overwhelming.
A new beginning can be beautiful and exciting, but it can also feel frightening when so many things are changing at once.
You don’t have to pretend to be strong every second. Your feelings are valid, and asking for support does not make you weak.
scenes.highlight: Even when I cannot solve every problem, I’ll always be here to listen, support you and remind you that you are stronger than you realise.

scenes.headline: You’re going to be okay, Stranger.
lines: Take everything one day at a time.
Ask for support whenever you need it.
Never believe that your feelings are a burden.
You deserve to feel heard, respected, supported and loved.
scenes.quote: A new chapter does not erase who you are. It gives you another place to grow.

scenes.headline: One honest message.
body: This birthday arrives just before one of the biggest chapters of your life.
I know everything may not feel easy right now, but I hope you remember how strong, capable and deserving of happiness you are.
You do not need to have everything figured out today. Move forward at your own pace and never be afraid to say when something feels wrong or overwhelming.
Whatever happens, Stranger, you will always have someone cheering for you.
scenes.highlight: You’re going to be okay. More than okay—you’re going to create a beautiful life.
scenes.signature:
Always here to listen, support and annoy you,
Praveen

modal.title: Of course you clicked it.
modal.body: You really don’t listen, Stranger. Anyway, I hope this year gives you countless reasons to smile—and fewer reasons to overthink.

content.secondary: The Stranger begins another beautiful chapter.
content.supporting: Not alone. Not without hope. And definitely not without someone to annoy her.
content.closing: This isn’t the end. It’s just a new beginning.

scenes.final_note: No matter where this next chapter takes you, never forget your worth. Keep smiling, believe in yourself and stay wonderfully strange. I’ll be rooting for you.

final_instruction: This is not a birthday-card website — it's a short, obsessively art-directed digital experience built entirely from light, type, and 3D form, with no photographs anywhere. Ivory carries the whole design; oxblood and champagne gold are used sparingly and deliberately for emotion and shine. The exact phrase 'HelLo, Stranger...' must be the first main text shown.
